about_the_game:
FELLOWSHIP is a multiplayer online dungeon adventure set in an exciting fantasy setting, with endlessly scaling dungeon runs. Players must focus on working together as a team, with an emphasis on skill, cooperation, and strategy to defeat bosses, collect loot, and work together to overcome ever-present challenges.

Gather Your Perfect Group

Jump in through matchmaking or team up with friends to take on challenging Dungeons. Choose from a growing roster of Heroes spanning Tank, DPS, and Healer roles, and freely swap between them to tackle each Dungeon your way. Cooperation and strategy are key as you face enemies with unique, complex mechanics.

Every run rewards you with personal loot and account-wide resources, ensuring each victory pushes you toward greater power. As FELLOWSHIP grows, new Heroes encompassing classic archetypes and bold new designs will expand the roster so every player can find their perfect playstyle.

Progress Through the Leagues

Unlock new Abilities, Talents, and powerful gear as you climb through Contender, Adept, Champion and Paragon Leagues.

Core League Dungeons feature a single Boss and take 10–15 minutes, perfect for fast, focused runs while Capstone Dungeons challenge you with three Bosses and must be conquered before advancing to the next League.

Each League introduces fresh twists with new enemy abilities, added Curses, and tougher encounters. The greater the challenge, the greater the reward: higher-level gear, Legendaries, Set items, Gems, and account-wide upgrades that fuel the progression of all your Heroes.

Take on the Eternal Challenge

For players seeking the ultimate test, Eternal offers endlessly scaling Dungeons where strategy, teamwork, and mastery decide how far you can push.

Compete on FELLOWSHIP’s in-game Leaderboards and prove your place among our greatest players.

Content-Driven Seasonal Resets

Every Season brings major content drops with new Heroes, Dungeons, features, and gameplay. Seasonal resets place everyone on a level playing field; perfect for jumping back in with friends.

All cosmetics, mounts, and account flair you've earned across previous Seasons stay with you permanently, letting you showcase your accomplishments throughout the lifetime of FELLOWSHIP.

content_descriptors.notes: Players will engage in combat with a variety of fantasy creatures. Combat is viewed from the third-person camera and while there is no depiction of blood the fantasy violence on display may not be suitable for all ages.

detailed_description:
Supporter Edition

We appreciate all the support from the Fellowship community! If you'd like to show extra support for Fellowship, you can purchase the Supporter Edition for some exclusive visual variants to let all other Fellows know that you love Fellowship!

The Supporter Edition includes Fellowship & all 3 Supporter Packs. These Supporter Packs are for Fellows who believe in what we’re building and want to see the Fellowship grow stronger and face deadlier threats.

Your support directly fuels the continued development of the game, future Heroes, more Dungeons, and new updates for all who fight for the Fellowship. In return, you’ll receive the following Supporter Packs:

The Guardian’s Supporter Pack

Crafted by the realm’s greatest artisans for guardians of legend: Helena, Mara, and Vigour. Three unique armor and weapon cosmetics, one for each associated Hero, and a noble spirit mount that can be ridden by any Hero!

  • Helena’s Frostsworn Protector Ensemble

  • Mara’s Timewraith Visage Ensemble

  • Vigour’s Deepwarden’s Oath Ensemble

  • Guardian Ghostclaw Mount

The Exile’s Supporter Pack

Armaments crafted for heroes and villains forged by destiny: Meiko, Ardeos, and Sylvie. Three unique armor and weapon cosmetics, one for each associated Hero, and a ferocious spirit mount that can be ridden by any hero!

  • Meiko’s Purifier's Raiments Ensemble

  • Ardeos’s Null Disciple Ensemble

  • Sylvie’s Everdawn Tangle Ensemble

  • Vengeful Vermin Mount

The Wanderer’s Supporter Pack

Mythic equipment befitting heroes who wander the land in search of evil: Elarion, Tariq, and Rime. Three unique armor and weapon cosmetics, one for each associated Hero, and a guiding spirit mount that can be ridden by any Hero!

  • Elarion’s Drakebound Hunt Ensemble

  • Tariq’s Abyssal Touch Ensemble

  • Rime’s Wildspring Oracle Ensemble

  • Radiant Feline Mount

These packs contain purely cosmetic items and unique cosmetic mounts. They are a mark of those who stood with us early, when Fellowship was still being forged.

From all of us at the Chief Rebel:

Your support means the world and we cannot wait to continue building Fellowship with you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
